questions.subject: Radiology
questions.prompt: IDENTIFY THE DIAGNOSIS FROM THE GIVEN CT SCAN.
questions.explanation:
THE CT SCAN SHOWING BALLOONING OF THE LEFT RENAL PELVIS WITH MODERATE HYDRONEPHROSIS OF THE
AFFECTED KIDNEY INDICATING A LIKELY DIAGNOSIS OF URETEROPELVIC JUNCTION OBSTRUCTION (UPJ)OF THE LEFT
SIDE.
PUJ OBSTRUCTION REFERS TO A BLOCKAGE OR NARROWING AT THE JUNCTION WHERE THE RENAL PELVIS
TRANSITIONS INTO THE URETER, LEADING TO IMPAIRED DRAINAGE OF URINE FROM THE KIDNEY.
INDICATIONS FOR SURGERY IN PATIENTS WITH UPJ OBSTRUCTION INCLUDE:
- ON THE DIURETIC RENOGRAM, UPJO WITH LESS THAN 40% IN THE SPLIT FUNCTION OF THE AFFLICTED KIDNEY.
- RENAL PARENCHYMAL ATROPHY IN THE PRESENCE OF SEVERE BILATERAL UPJO.
- DESPITE PREVENTIVE MEDICINES, RECURRING URINARY TRACT INFECTIONS.
- OBSTRUCTIVE UPJO THAT IS SYMPTOMATIC OR LINKED WITH AN ABDOMINAL MASS
HYDRONEPHROSIS MAY BE DETECTED ON ANTENATAL ULTRASOUND; IT CAN, HOWEVER, BE TRANSIENT OR MILD
AND RESOLVES ON ITS OWN. RE-EVALUATION SHOULD BE DONE AFTER BIRTH AND IN CASES PRESENTING WITH
SYMPTOMS OF RECURRENT UTI, PALPABLE FLANK MASS OR PAIN, URINARY OBSTRUCTION, AND IN CASES OF
FAILURE TO THRIVE.
IF THE HYDRONEPHROSIS IS PERSISTENT, ITS SEVERITY IS GRADED BY THE EXTENT OF THE DILATATION OF THE
PELVICALYCEAL SYSTEM AND PARENCHYMAL THICKNESS. IT NEEDS TO BE ASCERTAINED WHETHER THE OTHER
KIDNEY IS INVOLVED, THE LOWER URETER IS DILATED, THE BLADDER WALL IS THICKENED, AND WHETHER
EMPTYING OF THE BLADDER IS INCOMPLETE. BASED ON THESE FINDINGS, A DIAGNOSIS CAN BE MADE.
IN CASES OF HYDRONEPHROSIS, LONG-STANDING URINE STASIS AND PRESSURE MAY DAMAGE THE KIDNEYS.
THE CAUSES OF UPJ OBSTRUCTION ARE
- INTRINSIC (DUE TO AN ADYNAMIC OR STENOTIC SEGMENT OF THE PROXIMAL URETER) OR
- EXTRINSIC (E.G. COMPRESSION BY ACCESSORY RENAL ARTERIES). THIS NEEDS TO BE CORRECTED PRIMARILY.
THE RENAL ANATOMY AND FUNCTION CAN BE ASSESSED USING RADIOSCINTIGRAPHY STUDIES.
THE INVESTIGATION OF CHOICE FOR UPJ OBSTRUCTION IS 99MTC-MERCAPTOACETYL-TRIGLYCINE (MAG3)
SCAN. MICTURATING CYSTOURETHROGRAM IS THE INVESTIGATION OF CHOICE IN VESICOURETERIC REFLUX.
99MTC-DIMERCAPTOSUCCINIC ACID (DMSA) SCAN IS USED FOR ASSESSING RENAL SCARRING.
TREATMENT OF INTRINSIC UPJ OBSTRUCTION IS DONE SURGICALLY IF RENAL FUNCTION IS COMPROMISED OR IF
THERE IS BILATERAL INVOLVEMENT OF THE KIDNEYS. IN OTHER CASES, SERIAL FOLLOW-UP WITH ULTRASONOGRAPHY
IS DONE TO ASSESS THE SPONTANEOUS RESOLUTION OF HYDRONEPHROSIS.
SURGICAL OPTIONS INCLUDE PYELOPLASTY WHICH ENTAILS THE SURGICAL DIVISION OF THE OBSTRUCTION AND THE
CREATION OF A FUNNEL-SHAPED ANASTOMOSIS. ADDITIONALLY, A TEMPORARY STENT AND A DRAIN MAY BE
INSERTED. IT IS NECESSARY TO DO FURTHER SERIAL ULTRASOUNDS AND MAG-3 IMAGING IN ORDER TO ENSURE
PROPER MONITORING AND EVALUATION. THIS PROCEDURE IS NOW COMMONLY BEING PERFORMED VIA
LAPAROSCOPY AND ALSO WITH ROBOTIC ASSISTANCE. CONGENITAL PUJ OBSTRUCTION IS TREATED SURGICALLY BY
ANDERSON HYEN'S PYELOPLASTY.
BELOW ARE CT SCANS OF A LEFT PUJ OBSTRUCTION BEFORE(LEFT) AND AFTER(RIGHT) SURGERY.
4066
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION B: A RENAL CYST WOULD APPEAR AS A FLUID-FILLED, WELL-DEMARCATED STRUCTURE WITHIN THE KIDNEY
BUT DOES NOT INVOLVE THE PUJ OR CAUSE OBSTRUCTION.
OPTION C: A RENAL TUMOR WOULD PRESENT AS A SOLID, ABNORMAL MASS WITHIN THE KIDNEY, NOT TYPICALLY
INVOLVING THE PUJ UNLESS THERE IS DIRECT EXTENSION.
OPTION D: MULTICYSTIC KIDNEY REFERS TO THE PRESENCE OF MULTIPLE CYSTS WITHIN THE KIDNEY, OFTEN
CONGENITAL, BUT IS NOT SPECIFIC TO THE PUJ AND WOULD NOT RESULT IN OBSTRUCTION AT THE PUJ.

questions.subject: Radiology
questions.prompt: WHAT DOES THIS IMAGE BELOW INDICATE?
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN MRCP IMAGE SHOWING SACCULAR DILATATION OF THE COMMON BILE DUCT SUGGESTS A DIAGNOSIS
OF TYPE I CHOLEDOCHAL CYST.
TODANI CLASSIFICATION:
- TYPE I- SACCULAR DILATATION OF THE WHOLE (IA) OR A SEGMENT (IB) OF THE COMMON BILE DUCT (CBD)
- TYPE II- DIVERTICULUM FROM THE CBD
- TYPE III- CHOLEDOCHOCELE THAT OPENS INTO THE DUODENUM
- TYPE IV- MULTIPLE CYSTS (BOTH INTRAHEPATIC AND EXTRAHEPATIC)
- TYPE V- MULTIPLE CYSTS THAT ARE ONLY INTRAHEPATIC (CAROLI'S DISEASE)
THE DIAGNOSIS IS MADE INITIALLY WITH A RIGHT UPPER QUADRANT ULTRASOUND, FOLLOWING WHICH A
CONFIRMATORY MRCP CAN BE CARRIED OUT TO HELP IN PRE-OPERATIVE PLANNING.
TREATMENT IS USUALLY SURGICAL WITH A ROUX-EN-Y HEPATICOJEJUNOSTOMY WITH RADICAL RESECTION OF ALL
THE BILIARY TISSUE. THERE IS A RISK OF MALIGNANT TRANSFORMATION IN LONG-STANDING DISEASE, SO SURGICAL
REMOVAL IS USUALLY RECOMMENDED.
OTHER OPTIONS:
4067
OPTION B: GALL BLADDER CARCINOMA WOULD SHOW ABNORMAL GROWTHS OR MASSES IN THE GALL BLADDER
RATHER THAN CYSTIC DILATIONS OF THE BILE DUCTS.
OPTION C: CHOLANGIOCARCINOMA IS A MALIGNANCY OF THE BILE DUCTS AND WOULD PRESENT AS IRREGULAR
MASSES OR BILE DUCT STRICTURES RATHER THAN CYSTIC STRUCTURES.
OPTION D: CHOLEDOCHOLITHIASIS REFERS TO THE PRESENCE OF STONES IN THE BILE DUCT, WHICH WOULD
APPEAR AS FILLING DEFECTS WITHIN THE BILE DUCTS RATHER THAN CYSTIC DILATIONS.

questions.subject: Radiology
questions.prompt: IDENTIFY THE CONDITION SHOWN IN THE IMAGE:
questions.explanation:
AS THE GIVEN IMAGE SHOWS, THERE ARE MULTIPLE CALCIFICATIONS WITHIN THE REGION OF THE PANCREAS,
WHICH IS CHARACTERISTIC OF CHRONIC CALCIFIC PANCREATITIS.
THIS CONDITION RESULTS FROM LONG-STANDING INFLAMMATION OF THE PANCREAS, LEADING TO THE DEPOSITION
OF CALCIUM. CHRONIC PANCREATITIS IS OFTEN ASSOCIATED WITH ALCOHOL ABUSE, GENETIC FACTORS, OR
RECURRENT ACUTE PANCREATITIS. THE CALCIFICATIONS ARE A HALLMARK FEATURE AND HELP DIFFERENTIATE IT
FROM OTHER ABDOMINAL PATHOLOGIES.
IT PRESENTS WITH SYMPTOMS LIKE CHRONIC ABDOMINAL PAIN WITH A HISTORY OF ALCOHOLISM AND BULKY
STOOLS WHICH INDICATES A LACK OF PANCREATIC LIPASES SEEN IN CHRONIC DISEASE LEADING TO IMPAIRED FAT
DIGESTION AND ABSORPTION.
CHRONIC PANCREATITIS IS A PROGRESSIVE INFLAMMATORY DISEASE IN WHICH THERE IS AN IRREVERSIBLE
DESTRUCTION OF PANCREATIC TISSUE. IT IS MORE COMMON IN MALES, WITH A MALE: FEMALE RATIO OF 4:1.
THE ETIOLOGY OF CHRONIC PANCREATITIS AND PANCREATIC EXOCRINE INSUFFICIENCY CAN BE CLASSIFIED BASED
ON THE TIGAR-O CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM:
- TOXIC-METABOLIC -ALCOHOL, SMOKING, HYPERCALCEMIA, HYPERLIPIDEMIA
- IDIOPATHIC
- GENETIC- PRSS1, CFTR, AND SPINK1 GENES
- AUTOIMMUNE- AUTOIMMUNE CHRONIC PANCREATITIS, IGG4-RELATED DISEASE
- RECURRENT AND SEVERE ACUTE PANCREATITIS
- OBSTRUCTIVE- PANCREAS DIVISUM, DUCT OBSTRUCTION, MALIGNANCY
THE DIAGNOSIS CAN BE MADE USING ROSEMONT CRITERIA. IT IS BASED ON ENDOSCOPIC ULTRASONOGRAPHIC
(EUS) FINDINGS. IT IS EXPLAINED IN THE PEARL ATTACHED BELOW.
ERCP IS THE MOST SENSITIVE RADIOLOGIC TEST FOR THE DIAGNOSIS OF CHRONIC PANCREATITIS.

WITH CONDITIONS LIKE ISCHEMIA.
OPTION C: HORSESHOE KIDNEY INVOLVES THE KIDNEYS AND DOES NOT CAUSE PANCREATIC CALCIFICATIONS.

questions.subject: Radiology
questions.prompt:
A 6-YEAR-OLD CHILD PRESENTED WITH SEIZURES WHICH SUBSIDED WITH INJECTION MIDAZOLAM. BLOOD
INVESTIGATIONS AND LUMBAR PUNCTURE STUDIES WERE NORMAL. MRI IS DONE AND THE IMAGE IS GIVEN
BELOW. WHAT IS THE NEXT BEST INVESTIGATION OF CHOICE FOR FURTHER ASSESSMENT?
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN CLINICAL HISTORY OF A CHILD ALONG WITH AN MRI SHOWING A RING-ENHANCING INTRAAXIAL LESION
OF THE BRAIN COULD LIKELY BE A TUBERCULOMA OR NEUROCYSTICERCOSIS AND MR SPECTROSCOPY WOULD BE
THE NEXT BEST INVESTIGATION FOR FURTHER ASSESSMENT.
MAGNETIC RESONANCE (MR) SPECTROSCOPY IS A NON-INVASIVE TEST BASED ON THE PRINCIPLE OF MAGNETIC
RESONANCE USED TO ANALYSE THE METABOLITE DISTRIBUTION WITHIN THE BRAIN TISSUE. IT CONTAINS N-ACETYL
ASPARTATE (NAA), A NEURONAL VIABILITY SIGNAL; CHOLINE (A COMPONENT OF CELL MEMBRANES AND A
MARKER OF CELLULAR TURNOVER); CREATINE (PRESENT IN METABOLICALLY ACTIVE TISSUES); LIPIDS (RELEASED WITH
CELL MEMBRANE DISRUPTION); AND LACTATE (A HALLMARK OF ANAEROBIC METABOLISM).
THE IMAGE BELOW SHOWS A NORMAL MR SPECTROSCOPY.
4069
IN TUBERCULOMA, MR SPECTROSCOPY HAS REDUCED NAA OWING TO THE DESTRUCTION OF THE NORMAL BRAIN
PARENCHYMA AND INCREASED LEVELS OF LACTATE OR LIPIDS. IN NEUROCYSTICERCOSIS, THERE IS REDUCED NAA
AND CREATINE AND ELEVATED LACTATE, ALANINE, SUCCINATE, AND CHOLINE LEVELS.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION B- OCULAR B- SCAN IS DONE TO RULE OUT DISEASES IN THE POSTERIOR SEGMENT IN THE PRESENCE OF
MEDIA OPACITIES WHICH IS NOT SIGNIFICANT FOR THIS CASE.
OPTION C- CBNAAT OF CSF WILL NOT BE THE NEXT INVESTIGATION AS THE LUMBAR PUNCTURE ANALYSIS WAS
NORMAL.
OPTION D- PET-CT IS DONE TO ASSESS THE STAGE OF CANCER AND IS HENCE NOT REQUIRED IN THIS CASE.4070
